justification: A shows a single large naturalistic standing man in profile with elaborate headdress, robe and spear held vertically, rendered in modelled relief with careful anatomical and drapery detail; B shows multiple small schematic boats with upturned prows and rows of stroke-like crew marks scattered over a rock surface. The only overlap is the presence of human representation and vertical strokes, which is generic; the subject matter, scale, composition and drawing conventions are entirely different.
